purpose: Follow-up hardening after phase7, with process template and UI-readiness focus for an upcoming Blazor WASM PWA Tetris process run.
criticalFindings: Potential build breaker: ProcessRuntimeViewModels references ProcessStepRecoveryOption.None while ProcessDefinitionEnums currently shows ProcessStepRecoveryOption without None.
Blazor templates still allow product mutation in review/revalidation/escalation-style steps.
Non-Blazor templates remain largely unmigrated to persisted AllowedOperations and OperationTargetScope.
Processes API skill is too thin and does not document typed governance fields, block causes, recovery options, projection lineage, workflow/subprocess mappings, or Tetris test workflow.
Project-structure mutation tools are not visibly classified/enforced as governed external actions in AgentToolInvocationPolicyMetadata.
Manual/API step transition still risks weaker required-artifact validation than the automation finalizer path.
